steps.title: Analyze Build Error
steps.description: Inspected the build log and identified the missing or misconfigured 'android:exported' attribute in the launcher activity tag.

steps.title: Remove Package Attribute from Manifest
steps.description: Remove the deprecated package attribute from the manifest tag to comply with modern Gradle namespace practices.

steps.title: Configure Absolute Activity Class Name
steps.description: Update MainActivity declaration with its fully qualified name com.generatedappname.app.MainActivity to avoid relative path resolution issues.

steps.title: Inject Explicit Exported Attribute
steps.description: Explicitly define android:exported='true' on MainActivity so that Android 12+ devices can launch the activity correctly.

steps.title: Apply Icon Directives
steps.description: Configure the manifest application tag to use the correct drawable/icon resource as requested by build parameters.

steps.title: Verify Namespaces and Gradle Options
steps.description: Ensure the namespace inside build.gradle matches com.generatedappname.app.

steps.title: Verify Java Code
steps.description: Confirm Java class handles calculations offline without relying on external servers.

steps.title: Verify Main Layout XML
steps.description: Confirm the layout file is aligned with the MainActivity elements.

steps.title: Verify Proguard Rules
steps.description: Confirm keeping necessary entry classes intact during compile-time optimization.

steps.title: Building Calculator
steps.description: Execute the Gradle build process to successfully generate the debug APK.
